name: Wooden Hammer
old_description: At Wooden Hammer, we craft high-quality custom cabinetry and woodwork, with an eye towards sustainability. Our shop, in Monkton, Vermont, is small by design, allowing us to provide the highest level of care and personal service to the homeowners, builders, designers, and architects that we work with. By taking the time to listen to our customers and learn about their unique cabinetry and woodworking needs we become fully invested in each project we take on.
about:
Wooden Hammer operates a woodworking shop in Monkton, Vermont, nestled in the state's Champlain Valley. The company was founded in 2009 by Ben Raphael after he graduated cum laude from Colby College in Maine and apprenticed with two skilled carpenters. Raphael began building tree houses and forts from salvaged lumber as a child in Panton, Vermont, and translated that early hands-on experience into a professional cabinetry and furniture practice.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, fine furniture, and creative woodwork including kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, built-ins, and tables. The facility remains small by design, staffed by Raphael and one assistant, allowing direct communication between the craftsman and the client from initial contact through project completion. The company works with Vermont-sourced wood products as well as building materials sourced nationally, depending on client preference.

Wooden Hammer serves homeowners, builders, designers, and architects primarily in Vermont and the broader Northeast. Testimonials reference projects for clients in Burlington, South Burlington, and Manhattan, New York. The business focuses on residential and light commercial projects where personalized design and craftsmanship are prioritized over volume production.

Raphael established the company to avoid assembly-line construction and bulk distribution, emphasizing sustainability and attention to detail. The firm's differentiator is its scale: a two-person operation that delivers the highest level of care and personal service, with the actual maker involved at every stage.
